adminApiVersionVerified.source: Shopify Dev MCP v1.16.0 learn_shopify_api(api=admin) default version

accessScopes._policy: Least privilege. A scope moves from 'planned' to 'requested' only with a DEC entry.

planned.why: Create/update products, variants, collections, product metafields, SEO fields
Set inventory quantities when fulfilment model requires it
Analytics: orders, AOV, refunds (last 60 days without read_all_orders)
Create pages (FAQ, About, Contact) and blog articles

explicitlyNotRequested: read_customers / write_customers (not needed until lifecycle email requires it; PII)
read_all_orders (needs Shopify approval; only if >60-day history required)
